findings.evidence: SHA256 hashes in 0.0147 ms per operation. No work factor — computes in microseconds. GPUs can test billions of SHA-256 passwords per second. Should never be used for password storage. Dictionary attack recovered password "password123" in 0.07 ms after 2 attempt(s).

summary: 1 vulnerability(s) found. Unsafe algorithms: sha256. Safe algorithms (no findings): bcrypt, scrypt, argon2. Replace fast hashes with bcrypt (cost ≥12), scrypt, or argon2id.
